_comment: Cowork reads MCP servers only from a plugin; the repo-root .mcp.json serves Claude Code. Keep the version pin identical in both. Cowork passes the server no folder, so it accepts uploads only from --output-dir and its own start folder. Both servers point --output-dir at job-finder/.playwright-mcp in the user's home folder: playwright through HOME (macOS, Linux), playwright-win through USERPROFILE (Windows). A server whose variable is unset does not start. Nothing here takes effect until the plugin is rebuilt (sh scripts/py scripts/build_cowork_plugin.py) and uploaded again.
